subtitles.en: As a guy who lives in Brooklyn and grew up in the Bronx, I did not know that Westchester County would be a place we would be talking about tonight.
subtitles.zh: 作为一个住在布鲁克林、在布朗克斯长大的人，我没想到今晚我们会讨论威彻斯特县。

subtitles.en: Listen, no Mike Lawler very well. When I go to Capitol Hill, I see him quite a bit.
subtitles.zh: 听着，我很了解迈克·劳勒。我去国会山时经常见到他。

subtitles.en: Kate Conlay, a good friend, is running her campaign, so I stayed out of that coverage.
subtitles.zh: 凯特·康利是我的好朋友，正在负责他的竞选，所以我避开了那部分报道。

subtitles.en: I did not know that that race would be something we'd be talking about because of the issue in Westchester County.
subtitles.zh: 我没想到那场选举会因为威彻斯特县的问题而成为我们讨论的话题。

subtitles.en: It makes up 30% of that district, and because of a change in who is on the ballot in that very specific area of the district, polls, sites had issues this morning,
subtitles.zh: 该县占该选区的30%，由于该选区特定区域的选票候选人发生变化，今天早上投票站出现了问题，

subtitles.en: no tabulation of ballots by the machine.
Instead, they're going to be done by hand. And so done by hand, put in a red envelope, and then taken by Westchester County police to get tabulated.
subtitles.zh: 相反，他们将手工计票。手工计票后放入红色信封，然后由威彻斯特县警察送去统计。

subtitles.en: It was all done under the watchful eye of Democrats and Republicans, but another race in which you expect there will be very premium loyering happening there,
subtitles.zh: 整个过程在民主党和共和党的监督下进行，但另一场选举中，预计会有非常昂贵的律师费用，

subtitles.en: not just premium loyering, premium government affairs, lobbying, all of that kind of stuff will be happening because this race may not be called tonight because of the tabulation issues.
subtitles.zh: 不仅是昂贵的律师费用，还有昂贵的政府事务、游说等，都会发生，因为计票问题，这场选举今晚可能无法宣布结果。

subtitles.en: All right, on the billable hours beat for us, your Miles Miller, thank you very much. Appreciate that update.
subtitles.zh: 好的，感谢迈尔斯·米勒为我们带来的计费工时报道。感谢你的更新。

clip_research.source_claim: Westchester County voting machines had issues this morning, so ballots will not be machine-tabulated but hand-counted, placed in red envelopes, and taken by Westchester County police to be tabulated.
clip_research.public_baseline: Multiple outlets (PIX11, Newsweek, Fox News, CBS News, Firstpost) confirm Westchester County voting machines failed to accept/scan paper ballots on Election Day, and officials said all ballots would still be counted.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The specific detail that ballots were placed in red envelopes and transported by county police to be tabulated is not corroborated by the snippets; sources describe emergency ballot bags and counting assurances, not police transport.

evidence.fact: Speaker says no machine tabulation; ballots hand-counted, put in red envelope, taken by Westchester County police.

forbidden_claims: That ballots were definitively transported by Westchester County police in red envelopes (not corroborated by snippets).
That the race result was officially called or decided on the night.
That 'Kate Conlay' is the correct spelling of the candidate's name (public sources say Cait Conley).
That Westchester County makes up exactly 30% of the district (not verified by snippets).

notes: Transcript spelling 'Kate Conlay' conflicts with public sources naming Cait Conley; treat as a likely mishearing.
'premium loyering' appears garbled; likely 'premium lawyering' but unverified.
Police red-envelope transport detail is transcript-only and not corroborated by public snippets.
